verdict.rationale: Apify's site names Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, and Scrapy, alongside Crawlee, as supported for both Python and JavaScript. Supporting docs cover developing your own Actors, SDK toolkits, ready-made Docker base images, `apify create` scaffolding, and migrating existing projects, so developers can bring these libraries onto the platform. Missing for 10: in-depth per-library documentation or templates (e.g., Scrapy or Selenium integration guides), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with these libraries on Apify.
